static_traits.name: 郭立成
static_traits.social_status: 有几位密友，但尚not yet与他们讨论Self-doubt；分居后社交与支持系统受影响
static_traits.medical_history: without显著既往身心疾病史；without既往心理咨询或治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性强、配合度高；能识do not并描述自身的认知偏差（如negate积极、心理过滤）；态度积极，愿意尝试新方法

basic_info.main_problem: 尽管作为Lawyer赢得了第一个大案，我仍在与Self-doubt和not够好的感受作斗争，并且总是negate自己成就中的积极面。
basic_info.core_demands: I really want to change my mindset and stop belittling my achievements. This has affected my work and personal life too much.
growth_experiences: 约6个月前妻子离开后开始出现并加重Self-doubt与not够好的感受；分居与工作压力被视为诱因；社交与支持系统受影响（虽有几位密友但not yet谈及Self-doubt）；日常生活受损（跑步兴趣下降、变得像任务）。

special_situations.event: 赢下职业生涯中的第一个大案后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成功并非完美或完全归因于我的能力，那就not算真正的成功，说明我仍然not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 寻求同事的认可、放大瑕疵以自我鞭策，从而避免面对“自己not够好”的威胁感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这案子谁都能赢/只是运气好

special_situations.event: 同事对其工作给予表扬时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人夸奖我，他们多半只是出于礼貌而非真心；若我接受赞美就会暴露自己的not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Belittles and avoids internalizing positive feedback, verbally downplays praise to protect the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客套，我其实并have not做得好

special_situations.event: 在专业场合、特do not是重大成就之后回顾工作
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有任何错误或瑕疵，就说明整体是失败，我就not够格
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses on problems and mistakes, repeatedly self-criticizing to force oneself to work harder
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 有这些失误，我就not配得到称赞

special_situations.event: Self-evaluation that appeared in work settings after marital separation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果伴侣离开了我，说明I am not worthy of being loved，我在其他方面也not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively pursues external recognition at work, using achievements to prove self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她离开是因为I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and loved (to be genuinely affirmed in intimate relationships and career)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate与被抛弃，担心自身not值得被爱
defense_goal: 通过贬低成就与外归因来避免面对被揭穿“并not够好”的恐惧
寻求外部验证以减轻Being rejected与not被爱的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、随时会露馅的自我

object_relations.object_representation: A significant other (partner) who will leave and reject him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When receiving positive feedback/praise in counseling or at work
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方只是出于礼貌或敷衍，真实态度是质疑与negate（移情：将自我not接纳Projection到他人）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 用轻描淡写或自嘲的语气negate赞美，强调“只是运气/他们太客气”，避免情感接触。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing own achievements or asked to summarize success factors
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将成功归因为外部偶然或他人帮助，以维持“I am not good enough”的内在图式
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes external conditions, luck, or favorable procedures, avoids talking about own ability and effort; tone is rational and restrained.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to attend to own feelings or positives (e.g., counselor focuses on achievement experience)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Separates emotion from events, turning to abstract analysis to avoid feelings of vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses analytical language in place of emotional description, maintains an objective tone, avoids self-appreciation or vulnerable expression.

有密友却not愿谈及Self-doubt，担心给他人增添负担
outcomes: 职业与日常活动Decreased drive，Low mood

manifestations: 赢得大案却难以内化成就，negate积极反馈
The running he once enjoyed becomes like a task; the fun decreases
outcomes: 快感缺失与成就感丧失
对工作与生活的投入与信心下降

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: During sessions, when others' praise is mentioned, considers it 'just politeness', finds it hard to accept positive feedback
将内心的not接纳归因为他人not真诚

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: When describing work performance, repeatedly blames himself and magnifies mistakes
对自我表达保持谨慎，担心显得“not够好”

positive_force: Has professional competence and objective achievements (won the first major case)
Positive attitude; willing to try new methods and do recording practice
Has a certain social support basis (several close friends)
negative_force: 分居事件导致的被抛弃感与Loneliness感
Overly dependent on external validation; hard to internalize positive feedback
negate积极与心理过滤的认知偏差
Persistent self-doubt与自我贬低影响工作与日常

target_behavior.behavior: 在取得成就后持续自我贬低并negate积极反馈，反复寻求他人认可
antecedent: Achieving notable accomplishments in professional settings (such as winning a big case)
收到同事或他人的表扬
target_behavior.core_reason: 婚姻分居后自我价值受损，形成“I am not good enough/not配成功”的负性核心信念，并通过negate积极与心理过滤维持该信念
target_behavior.function: 避免面对被negate或“露馅”的恐惧，同时通过外部认可短期缓解not安
target_behavior.consequence: 工作表现与Damaged confidence，兴趣活动（如跑步）乐趣下降，日常功能受影响
